facts.fact: The National Bank of Ethiopia revised its Licensing and Authorization of Payment Instrument Issuer Directive, raising the capital for a Payment Instrument Issuer company to 100 million Birr, per Ethiopian Monitor.
facts.system: Licensing and Authorization of Payment Instrument Issuer Directive

facts.fact: The National Bank of Ethiopia issued a revised Licensing and Authorization of Payment Instrument Issuer Directive in late May 2025, raising daily e-money transaction limits and issuer capital to 100 million Birr.

The revised directive makes interoperability among mobile wallets mandatory and requires financial institutions to participate in the Ethiopian Instant Payment System, per the National Bank of Ethiopia via Ethiopian Monitor.

systems.system: Licensing and Authorization of Payment Instrument Issuer Directive

ETH.note: Interoperability is mandated, not stated in service.
